Animate the APPROVED Tobin Fell pixel sprite in reference 1, matching this EXACT single facing in reference 2. This is a game animation source sheet, NOT a concept redesign. Make precisely SIX EQUAL COLUMNS by THREE EQUAL ROWS of 18 separate full-body poses on a transparent background. No labels, borders, scenery or cast shadow. All 18 cells same dimensions, character same scale and position within cell, feet share a baseline. Leave generous transparent gutters all around each full figure; NOTHING touches adjacent cells or edges. Crisp native pixel clusters like the 96x96 guide, about72 logical pixels body height, enlarged integer nearest-neighbor style, limited warm brown/charcoal/grey palette, no antialiasing/painterly smoothing. Older sturdy adult human blacksmith: swept grey hair with small low grey ponytail, full grey beard, rolled charcoal olive workshirt sleeves, brown gloves, worn soot-dark front leather apron, X-crossed apron straps on back, dark trousers/brown boots. Plain iron front buckle, square iron hammer BELTED anatomical RIGHT, repaired pouch/tongs anatomical LEFT. These sides never switch. NO glowing tools, sparks, weapons wielded, cloak, hat, bald head or armour. Both hands EMPTY. Keep head, equipment and apron recognizable and stable throughout, no extra limbs or morphs. SAME FACING FOR ALL18POSES, never rotate during clips. ROW1 = SIX IDLE FRAMES: gentle breathing through shoulders/chest, tiny natural beard/ponytail movement, arms relaxed, feet planted absolutely unchanged; neutral -> inhale1 -> inhale2 -> peak -> settle1 -> settle2. ROW2 = SIX WALK FRAMES, walking IN PLACE with grounded weight and slight arm swing, apron and belted tools responding gently: left foot contact, left down, passing, right foot contact, right down, passing. Both boots remain visible; no sliding torso across cells. ROW3 = SIX TALK FRAMES: calm gruff friendly blacksmith speaking, small mouth changes/front or slight shoulder/nod for rear views. Right EMPTY gloved hand gradually rises in a modest conversational gesture, left arm relaxed; feet planted and body facing fixed. Pose0rest,1begin,2rise,3gesture,4emphasis,5lower. Talk will play forward and reverse. Design and colors must remain identical across all rows. IMPORTANT: each row must contain exactly six images, all 18 bodies fully inside cells.
FACING FOR THIS ENTIRE SHEET: FRONT THREE QUARTER facing SCREEN RIGHT. Front bib/buckle, beard visible. Near anatomical RIGHT hip has square iron hammer. Pouch/tongs farther anatomical LEFT side, opposite hammer. Nose diagonally screen right.
